title: Set "browser": "headed" on h5-ec-csv-tool-note-1018 so the supervisor runs it headed (note editor rejects headless)
detail: note.com POST /api/v1/text_notes fails CORS preflight (net::ERR_FAILED) under the headless playwright-note server - reproduced 10/02, 10/18 10:02 and 10/18 10:12 JST. The 10/02 note publish succeeded only headed. mac_supervisor.py launches headed only when the task JSON has "browser": "headed" (mac-local may not set it). Founder: add that field to status/2026-10/tasks/h5-ec-csv-tool-note-1018.json and reopen; mac-local then publishes marketing/2026-10/h5/note_01.md as-is.
